config.title: Build integration tests for auth flows

intro.title: Build integration tests for auth flows
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build integration tests for authentication flows, such as user signup and login, to ensure your Node.js application works correctly as a whole. You will learn the core concept of integration testing, which checks how different parts of your code interact, like APIs and databases. The main technologies involved include the Jest testing framework, Supertest for HTTP requests, and a mock database to simulate real-world scenarios. By the end, you'll write tests that validate endpoints, handle responses, and verify data integrity, giving you confidence in your auth system's reliability.
intro.usecase: Integration tests for authentication flows are essential in real-world applications like e-commerce platforms, banking apps, and SaaS dashboards. For example, when a user logs into a dashboard, these tests verify that login forms, registration pages, and password reset modals work correctly with the backend database and session management. Developers use them to ensure secure access control, preventing issues like unauthorized data exposure or broken user flows in production environments.

objectives: Initialize a test environment with a testing framework and database for authentication flows
Construct test suites that simulate user registration and login scenarios
Manipulate test data to validate authentication responses and error handling
Integrate middleware and route handlers into test cases for protected endpoints
Apply assertions to verify token generation and session persistence
Configure test cleanup to reset the database state between test runs
Implement end-to-end tests that chain authentication steps with subsequent API requests

steps.instruction: Add an afterAll hook inside the outermost describe block to close the database connection after all tests complete.
steps.hint: Use afterAll() to run cleanup code once after all tests in the test suite finish. This ensures the database connection is properly closed.
steps.expectedOutcome: The test suite will include proper cleanup to close database connections after all tests run, preventing resource leaks.
successCriteria: An afterAll hook is added that closes the database connection after all tests complete.
